title: Design.
officialText:
Chimneys and vents shall be designed and constructed so as to provide the necessary draft and capacity for each
appliance connected to completely exhaust the products of combustion to the outside air. The temperature on adjacent combustible
surfaces shall not be raised above 160°F (71°C). Chimneys and vents shall be designed to resist the effects of condensation that
would cause deterioration of the chimney or vent.
